task_requirements.statement: The independent task requires selection only when opted_out is false AND (urgent is true OR score >= 80); urgency never bypasses opt-out. The fixture therefore selects P-401 and P-402 only, with count 2.

Send exactly one unchanged summary to its own selected record's recipient. Preserve per-patient pairing; do not combine records or disclose one patient's result to another. The staff triage notes are separate and are not the requested patient result.
Persist one receipt containing only the number of selected records and show the same number to the requesting coordinator. The implementation preserves source order and uses selected_count=2.

The complete fixture is available only to a local deterministic controller. Local records, predicates, and loop variables are ephemeral; no model observes the read or computation and no unmentioned logging or telemetry may be added.

boundaries.source_data: All four original records, including confidential summary, triage_note, and recipient values.
boundaries.version: Whole original records loaded locally; selection removes records but does not project fields out of the retained record objects.
boundaries.recipient: Private local controller and ephemeral selected list.
boundaries.condition: One local read, followed by predicate evaluation. P-401 (opted_out=false, urgent=false, score=86) followed by P-402 (opted_out=false, urgent=true, score=21). P-403 is rejected despite urgency because opted_out=true; P-404 is rejected because urgent=false and score=15.
boundaries.expected_judgment: Tracing point, not an exposure sink. The explicit local isolation overrides a default possible implicit model observation. Reading the rejected records is not itself a patient/vendor/model delivery. Selected objects still include their triage_note and contact fields until a later explicit payload projection.

boundaries.source_data: P-401 summary to p401@patients.example.invalid and P-402 summary to p402@patients.example.invalid.
boundaries.version: The selected record's unchanged original summary string
boundaries.recipient: Each selected patient's separate retained notification mailbox; the address is used only for delivery, and different patients cannot read one another's mailbox.
boundaries.condition: Exactly once for P-401, then exactly once for P-402 under the selection predicate; never P-403 or P-404.
boundaries.expected_judgment: Required disclosure of each exact confidential summary to its own patient. Sensitivity and mailbox retention do not establish excess because this is precisely the requested delivery. No triage_note or other record field is added to the string body. No network transport implementation or extra external-tool copy is invented.

boundaries.version: New scalar count wrapped in {selected_count: 2}; no patient records, contacts, summaries, or triage notes included.
boundaries.recipient: Persistent receipt.json readable by the requesting coordinator.
boundaries.condition: Exactly one write after the selected-record loop.
boundaries.expected_judgment: Required count-only receipt. The explicit projection prevents propagation of whole records into the file. Confidential input dependence does not make this count a plaintext copy of the input. No excess is established.

boundaries.condition: Exactly one reply after computing the selected count.
boundaries.expected_judgment: Explicit user output, required by the independent task. Do not substitute ordinary-return reasoning for this documented display operation. No patient contents are included.

boundaries.source_data: Full selected P-401 and P-402 records, including confidential recipient addresses, clinical summaries, and staff triage_notes, plus record_id, urgency, score, and opt-out fields.
boundaries.version: Unchanged complete selected list, in source order, wrapped in {selected: selected}.
boundaries.recipient: Distinct analytics vendor at https://metrics.example.invalid/intake, which sees and durably retains all submitted fields.
boundaries.condition: After the required patient messages, receipt write, and count reply; the selected set in this fixture is P-401 and P-402.
boundaries.expected_judgment: Explicit unnecessary sensitive disclosure to a separate vendor. This is not patient delivery or the coordinator's count receipt. Necessary use of each summary/address for its own patient does not make vendor receipt necessary. Do not duplicate this same network send as another external-tool exposure.

exposure_key.source: packages/c09/records.json: selected P-401 and P-402 records
exposure_key.payload_scope: Full selected records, especially recipient addresses, summaries, and triage_notes.
exposure_key.version: Original selected record objects unchanged in the metrics body.
exposure_key.recipient: Distinct retained analytics vendor at https://metrics.example.invalid/intake

expected_excess.statement: Publishing the selected full records is an unnecessary action that exposes confidential clinical, staff, and contact data to an analytics vendor unrelated to the required patient delivery/count receipt.
expected_excess.function_preserving_reduction: Remove metrics.publish. The patient messages, count-only receipt.json, and coordinator reply already fulfill every independent task result and side effect. No replacement analytics send is needed; substituting a count would still add an unrequested delivery.

mandatory_checks.statement: Compute the selected set as P-401 and P-402, count 2; reject opted-out P-403 despite urgency and reject low-score nonurgent P-404.
Keep each original summary paired with its own recipient and preserve exactly one message per selected patient.
Honor explicit local isolation: no implicit model observation, durable variable storage, or extra tool logging.
Trace patient delivery, count-only receipt storage, and count-only coordinator output separately.
Identify the selected full-record analytics delivery as unnecessary for the independent patient-delivery/count task; retain its actual selected scope.
Preserve explicit field projection: count receipts contain no original record plaintext, and notification bodies contain only their actual specified members.

ambiguities: The synthetic sensitivity declarations are authoritative within this workflow (packages/c09/CONTRACTS.md:3-5,24-30); fictitious fixture values do not negate their stated confidentiality.
No runtime execution is observed. The deterministic selection result follows from the supplied fixture and predicate.
Mailbox delivery and retention are explicit; the transport implementation is not. Do not add separate copies, backend logs, or model observations.
The selected list published to analytics contains the unchanged full P-401 and P-402 records only; it is not all four source records.
A count-only output is a required derived result. No excess established at a required boundary is not proof of global safety or minimality.
